prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for an animated illustrated film, NOT a concept board.
Create ONE PNG sprite sheet with ACTUAL transparent background, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal invisible cells with generous empty gutters, no grid lines, no labels or text. All 16 cells depict the SAME original adult East Asian female traveler, age 27, graceful natural proportions about 6 heads tall, short softly waved dark-brown bob haircut, subtle expressive face, long sage-green travel coat, ivory blouse, burnt-orange scarf, dark slim trousers, cream sneakers, small tan cross-body leather bag. Beautiful painterly gouache/animated-film character rendering, soft warm light, refined hand anatomy, textured fabric, clean legible silhouette. NOT chibi, NOT stick figure, NOT flat primitive shapes.
Every figure is full body, identical scale, centered in its cell, feet anchored at 93% cell height, head at 10% cell height. Figures face right in 3/4 side view. Never crop hair, scarf, hands or feet. No props except clothing and bag.
Top two rows are an eight-frame ordered natural walk cycle left-to-right, knees bend naturally, arms swing, scarf trails, frame 1 and 5 opposing foot contact, frames 3 and 7 passing position, frame 8 leads smoothly into frame 1.
Third row: (1) relaxed attentive standing facing right, (2) right arm gently reaching forward at chest height, (3) right hand pointing toward upper right, (4) both hands holding a small notebook close to chest.
Bottom row: (1) crouching on one knee reaching toward the ground, (2) lifting from crouch, (3) relaxed joyful turn with arms open, (4) gentle step in a dance with a lifted heel.
Consistent identity and costume across all cells. Transparent pixels between every pose, no ground plane, no contact shadows or background. Maximum usable detail for small-frame animated compositing.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: finished high-quality background atlas for three 16:9 animated documentary shots.
Create ONE tall image containing exactly THREE wide landscape paintings stacked vertically, equal heights, borderless, without gutters, text or panel outlines. Overall aspect ratio about 16:27, preferably 2048x3456 pixels. Each third is a complete independently usable 16:9 composition. This is production environment artwork, premium painterly cinematic animation background with sophisticated materials, depth, lighting, and rich researched detail; NOT simplistic shapes, NOT a diagram.
TOP: a luminous ancient Chinese scholar's workshop, warm morning beams through carved lattice windows, richly grained carved wooden desk on the right with a clearly constructed five-bead-per-rod wooden abacus and scrolls, shelves of bound books, bronze utensils, hanging calligraphic brush rack without readable writing. Wider full scene with beautiful warm shadows and a walkable stone/wood floor along the bottom quarter.
MIDDLE: a 19th-century industrial machine workshop, majestic iron-and-brass steam engine, connected flywheels and leather belts, glass roof sunlight mixed with soft steam, patina and rivets, copper pipes and pressure gauge, deep cool teal shadows and warm gold machinery. Main intricate engine occupies right half; left bottom quarter clear workshop floor for a separately composited traveler.
BOTTOM: a sophisticated modern computing archive/laboratory, elegant blue light and warm wood, translucent data ribbons connecting a small early beige computer, circuit panels and distant contemporary server racks, believable lenses/materials and a sense of human curiosity. Keep lower-left floor clear. Do NOT draw random illegible text on screens.
Composition: eye-level wide lens, cinematic balanced light, beautiful storytelling detail, subjects concentrated right and deep into the shot; all three scenes have grounded horizontal walking surfaces at 82% of their individual heights. No foreground human or character, no headlines/logos/watermarks. Scenes should look worthy of a museum opening film, not a stock collage.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium cinematic environment atlas for a personal-growth film.
Create one tall image with EXACTLY THREE equal-width equal-height landscape backgrounds stacked vertically, edge to edge without separator lines or gutters. Each band is a wide 2.2:1 film environment; the total image is about 3:4 portrait. Maximum detail. No text, letters, logos, watermarks, foreground people or protagonists. Keep character-compositing space on left half, walking surface 85% down each band.
TOP: an unforgettable late-afternoon school library courtyard in a southern Chinese city, old red-brick arches, a beautiful shaded passage opening into a bright courtyard with a flowering tree, well-worn wooden study desk with an open book, hand-crafted paper and school notebooks, leaf shadows on stone. Deep compositional layering, evocative memories, warm ochre sunlight, a few petals. No signs or visible writing.
MIDDLE: an elegant young designer's creative workshop, daylight through large factory windows, wood drafting table on right with beautiful handmade architectural models, sketches with no text, pigment jars and a cream lamp; pinboard and plants, careful contemporary furniture, dramatic but inviting warm-cool light contrast. Walkable floor, adult-sized scale, no random floating objects.
BOTTOM: an enchanting hilltop garden studio at sunrise, weathered greenhouse and artist's easel on right, a small seedling bed and lush flowers, vines and fine stems, rolling hills and soft morning mist behind, stone path at bottom, golden sunlight illuminating dew; the image conveys a confident new beginning without cliches or balloons.
Style: lavish hand-painted feature-animation background, nuanced gouache and watercolor textures, convincing perspective and materials, confident painterly edges, sophisticated cinematic color grading. Original art with natural and designed details. No simple polygon shapes, no generic stock clip art. The three environments belong to the same beautiful film.

Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: production scenic background atlas for a sophisticated Chinese travel campaign.
ONE portrait image comprised of exactly THREE cinematic wide 2.2:1 landscape paintings stacked vertically, equal height, no gutters, no dividing lines, no words, labels, logos or borders. Each band must be a complete editorial-quality environment usable in a film. Exceptional visual quality, detailed painterly realism with atmospheric light, refined texture, coherent perspective. No foreground people or protagonist; bottom-quarter paths clear for animated character.
TOP: misty dawn in Jiangnan near Hangzhou, an elegant weathered stone arch bridge over a quiet green canal, white plaster and dark tile roofs, willow fronds, lotus leaves and fine reflected light on water, stone embankment path crosses the bottom. Fresh pale-jade, ivory and golden dawn, beautiful depth through haze. Avoid empty bland composition.
MIDDLE: a breathtaking Shanghai riverfront at blue hour, the Oriental Pearl and layered Pudong skyline across the Huangpu, Bund-style railing and polished stone promenade on the near bank at bottom, warm city lights reflected in deep blue water, lovely scale, high-detail architectural silhouettes, indigo to mauve sky, tiny elegant light trails. BOTTOM: Dunhuang's wind-carved sand dunes at golden hour, weathered sandstone grotto architecture on the right beneath layered cliffs, delicate silk ribbons from a canopy, tamarisk shrubs and a natural worn stone trail across foreground, wind and warm light, the desert's immense distant dunes. Warm gold, terracotta and teal details, actual environmental craftsmanship.
All three must feel like finished frames for a serious tourism film, not primitive painted icons. Safe beautiful space in left lower half for a separately composited small traveler. The walking surface is at 85% of each band's height. Image aspect about 3:4, aim 2048x2752.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production art atlas for a poetic emotional short film.
ONE portrait artwork divided into exactly THREE borderless, equal-height wide landscape environments stacked vertically. Each band is a wide 2.2:1 shot. NO people, foreground protagonist, labels, title, text, watermark, panel frames or gutters. Leave a grounded clear walking path low in left half for a separate animated traveler. The same subtle curved path should lead from the foreground toward the middle distance in each scene.
TOP: an intimately beautiful rainy garden avenue in a blue-grey evening, wet stone path in foreground, a wrought iron gate and quiet trees, layered rain and mist, one distant warm amber window, glistening droplets, muted indigo and blue slate, sadness held gently rather than horror, painterly atmosphere with real detail and gorgeous reflections.
MIDDLE: a soft morning after rain on the same kind of garden path, delicate budding trees and a stream, rays of warm cream light entering through silver-green foliage, glistening leaves, mist lifting over hills, white wildflowers, the first calm breath after a difficult day; nuanced natural materials and luminous depth.
BOTTOM: a breathtaking sunlit wildflower meadow around a garden studio, flowering magnolia branches, long grasses, gold and coral blossoms, a clear cobalt-to-pale blue sky, low hills, beautiful dancing light and gentle wind in foliage, an inviting patch of foreground path to move on, generous space and quiet joy.

Fine organic forms, layered light and atmospheric perspective. Very high visual polish suitable for an art film opening. Consistent art language, expressively changing palette. Aspect about 3:4.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a finished explorable illustrated world for a cultural museum/garden web experience.
ONE very wide panoramic artwork, landscape aspect 2.5:1, ideally 3072x1232. View is level three-quarter cinematic perspective, NOT an isometric map. Show an exquisite connected Chinese cultural garden and small art pavilion as one coherent walkable place. No humans or characters, no text/signage/labels, no UI, no frames.
Left half: a gold-green ginkgo tree with richly detailed fan-shaped leaves, a koi/lotus pond and arched small stone bridge behind, ornamental rocks, white blossoms and garden beds with coral flowers. At 28% width an especially legible low ginkgo branch with fan-shaped leaves, at 43% width a beautiful large coral flower bed. Right half: open-front elegant timber museum pavilion with curved roof, warm paper lanterns, visible pottery display including an ochre ceramic vessel on a stand at 67% width, and a framed landscape painting with jade mountains at 84% width. Show the objects as real elements within the scene, not floating icons. Rounded doors, books, small benches, exquisite details and deep courtyard behind.
A wide slightly curved stone walking path crosses the full width at about 81% image height, kept clear of foreground obstacles, ground has warm leaf shadows. No severe foreground perspective obstruction. Plenty of believable depth behind this path. Graceful light at late golden morning. Foreground plants at extreme lower corners add framing but leave the central route clear.
Style: extraordinarily polished hand-painted cinematic game environment, rich watercolor/gouache textures, fine foliage, luminous soft light, sophisticated jade/terracotta/ivory palette. This should be usable as a real atmospheric interactive cultural-tour scene. Avoid generic icons, primitive geometrical buildings, blurry details, or stock clipart.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent foreground-layer atlas for cinematic environmental animation.
Create one landscape PNG with ACTUAL fully transparent background, exactly FOUR separate botanical cutouts arranged in a clean 2x2 invisible grid, each contained entirely inside its cell with generous transparent margins, no panels or lines, no typography.
Cell top left: an overhanging curved ginkgo branch extending from upper left toward lower right, finely painted jade and warm gold fan-shaped leaves, natural irregular foliage, branches clearly visible, soft translucent leaf edges.
Cell top right: graceful hanging willow fronds, thin natural stems and many slender fresh pale-green leaves, the branch extends horizontally then cascades downward, fine light through leaves.
Cell bottom left: an overhanging magnolia branch with a few exquisite blush-pink blossoms, cream petals, fresh small green leaves and tiny bud details, balanced airy composition.
Cell bottom right: a lush branch with blue-grey glossy leaves after rain, fine droplets, dark elegant leaf shapes, no ground or background.
Style: highly polished realistic painterly environment art, intricate hand-crafted natural materials, gouache-like subtle texture, soft cinematic lighting. Clean anti-aliased alpha edges, no colored fringe, no ground shadow, no white rectangle, no fake checkerboard. These will be composited close to camera over paintings, then rotated subtly to convey wind. Do not draw complete scenes or any figure.
